units.title: Global C² regularity of finite Hermite features
units.statement: Let \(E\) be a finite-dimensional real inner-product normed space with its Borel structure, and let \(\gamma_E=\operatorname{stdGaussian}(E)\) be the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. Let \(H_j\) be the unnormalized probabilists Hermite polynomial and put \(h_j(w)=[x\mapsto H_j(\langle w,x\rangle)]\in L^2(\gamma_E)\). For a finite set \(S\subset\mathbb N\) and real coefficients \(c_j\), put \(F_{S,c}(w)=\sum_{j\in S}c_jh_j(w)\). Every finite feature map \(F_{S,c}\) is globally twice continuously Fréchet differentiable on the entire ambient space.
assumptions: The finite-dimensional real inner-product and Borel structures are the actual structures on the same carrier \(E\).
\(\gamma_E\) is the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. No positive dimension restriction is imposed.
\(S\) is finite and \(c_j\) are arbitrary real coefficients. No unit-vector or series-convergence hypothesis is needed.

steps.title: Sum the smooth scalar multiples
steps.text: Each degreewise map is \(C^2\). Constant scalar multiplication preserves that regularity, and the sum is finite.
steps.formula: F_{S,c}=\sum_{j\in S}c_jh_j,\qquad h_j\in C^2\ \Longrightarrow\ F_{S,c}\in C^2.

theorem finiteGaussianHermiteRidgeL2_contDiff (s : Finset ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (finiteGaussianHermiteRidgeL2 (E := E) s c) := by
  unfold finiteGaussianHermiteRidgeL2
  exact ContDiff.sum fun j _ => (gaussianHermiteRidgeL2_contDiff j).const_smul (c j)
